name: large-file-guard
description: PreToolUse hook that blocks `git commit` and `git merge --continue` when the commit would include text files over a line-count threshold (default 1000). Incremental ratchet: only files touched by the commit are checked (merge conclusions count only content that differs from every parent); legacy large files do not block until modified. Resolves the tool-call cwd to its git top level; configurable via .large-file-guard.json there.
